The league season had two champions, with [[Club Atlético River Plate|River Plate]] winning the Apertura (25th. league title for the club), while [[Club Atlético Independiente|Independiente]] won the Clausura championship (15th. league title). [[Club Atlético Banfield|Banfield]] (as champion of [[1992–93 Primera B Nacional]]) and [[Gimnasia y Tiro]] (winner of "Torneo Octogonal" after beating [[Central Córdoba de Rosario]] in a two-legged series)[https://www.eltribuno.com/salta/nota/2015-8-7-18-2-0-hace-22-anos-el-pais-admiraba-a-gimnasia-y-tiro-gimnasia-y-tiro Hace 22 años, el país admiraba a Gimnasia y Tiro | Gimnasia y Tiro] on El Tribuno, 7 Aug 2015 promoted from the [[Primera Nacional|Primera B Nacional]] (second division)."Argentina: 1ra. "B" Nacional AFA 1992/93" by José Carluccio, 20 Feb 2012 On the other hand, Gimnasia y Tiro and [[Estudiantes de La Plata]] were relegated to Primera B Nacional.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/arg94.html Argentina 1993/94] by Pablo Ciullini on the RSSSF"Argentina: 1ra.
